theorem DecMap.sub_trans {M1 M2 M3 : DecMap} (h1 : M1 ⊆ M2) (h2 : M2 ⊆ M3) : M1 ⊆ M3

def DecCompat (M1 M2 : DecMap) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (v1 v2 : Option ConfChangeIM), M1 !! k = some v1 → M2 !! k = some v2 → v1 = v2

theorem DecCompat.symm {M1 M2 : DecMap} (h : DecCompat M1 M2) : DecCompat M2 M1

theorem DecCompat.sub_right {M1 M2 : DecMap} (hc : DecCompat M1 M2) : M2 ⊆ M1 ∪ M2

theorem DecCompat.sub_left (M1 M2 : DecMap) : M1 ⊆ M1 ∪ M2

theorem DecCompat.refl (M : DecMap) : DecCompat M M

def DecMap : Type :=
  GMap Nat (Option ConfChangeIM)

theorem DecCompat.of_sub {M1 M2 M : DecMap} (h1 : M1 ⊆ M) (h2 : M2 ⊆ M) : DecCompat M1 M2

theorem DecMap.empty_sub (M : DecMap) : ∅ ⊆ M

theorem DecMap.sub_refl (M : DecMap) : M ⊆ M
